biomarkers.name: KIT (CD117)
biomarkers.prevalence: ~95% IHC-positive; ~75-80% harbour KIT mutations (exon 11 most common ~65%, exon 9 ~10-15%)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic hallmark. Exon 11: imatinib-sensitive (400 mg). Exon 9: imatinib-sensitive at 800 mg. Sunitinib, regorafenib, ripretinib for subsequent lines. Some exon 17 activation-loop mutations are imatinib-resistant; avapritinib has activity against selected activation-loop mutants

biomarkers.name: DOG1 (ANO1)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic marker; often positive when KIT IHC negative

biomarkers.name: PDGFRA
biomarkers.clinical_use: PDGFRA D842V is imatinib-resistant; avapritinib is the standard. Non-D842V PDGFRA: imatinib

biomarkers.name: SDH-deficient (SDHA/B/C/D)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Distinct subtype: young patients, gastric, multifocal, KIT/PDGFRA wild-type, relatively imatinib-insensitive. Carney triad, Carney-Stratakis syndrome. SDHB IHC screens for SDH-deficient GIST

biomarkers.name: BRAF V600E
biomarkers.clinical_use: Rare alternative driver in KIT/PDGFRA-wild-type GIST; may support MAPK-directed therapy in selected cases

biomarkers.name: NF1 (germline)
biomarkers.prevalence: GIST occurs in a minority of NF1 patients
biomarkers.clinical_use: Multiple GISTs in small bowel; KIT/PDGFRA wild-type; often less sensitive to imatinib

biomarkers.name: NTRK / FGFR fusions
biomarkers.clinical_use: NTRK fusions predict sensitivity to larotrectinib or entrectinib; rare kinase fusions may occur in KIT/PDGFRA-wild-type GIST

biomarkers.name: Mitotic count, size, location
biomarkers.clinical_use: Modified NIH / AFIP risk stratification determines recurrence risk and supports adjuvant imatinib decisions (typically 3 years for high-risk imatinib-sensitive disease)

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Mesenchymal tumour of interstitial cells of Cajal — spindle cell, epithelioid, or mixed patterns
histomorphological_subtype.grading: AFIP / modified NIH risk categories based on size, mitotic index, location; not formally graded

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Variable; some inflammatory infiltrate but IO responses generally modest
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Sparse fibrous stroma; multinodular or diffuse growth

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Interstitial cells of Cajal (ICC) — the enteric pacemaker cells regulating GI motility
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — mesenchymal derivative of GI tract
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Retains ICC differentiation with CD117 (KIT) and DOG1 (ANO1) expression — both defining lineage markers
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: KIT-mutant, PDGFRA-mutant, and SDH-deficient (paediatric) subtypes represent distinct lineage biology; SDH-deficient GISTs have epithelioid morphology and different behaviour
